attributes.board_name: Hawaii Board of Physical Therapy (DCCA Professional and Vocational Licensing Division)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses in the professional practice of physical therapy or patient/client management from APTA or the Hawaii Chapter of APTA, FSBPT ProCert, courses approved by another state's PT board, or other Board-approved providers; transitional DPT coursework (10 CCUs per credit hour) and other activities listed in the Board booklet. Courses on techniques outside Hawaii's scope of practice (e.g. dry needling) are not accepted.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: license issued less than 12 months before the renewal date - no CCUs; issued more than 12 months before - 15 CCUs.
rules.audit_note: Attestation at renewal; random audits - documentation due within 14 calendar days of the request. Keep records 7 years after each course.

topics.who: 2 CCUs in ethics, laws and rules (jurisprudence), or a combination; Hawaii laws-and-rules courses must be approved by the Hawaii Board; ethics from any Board-recognized provider
4 CCUs life support for health care professionals, comparable to or more advanced than the AHA BLS health care provider course

rules.notes: 30 CCUs = at least 24 in professional practice or patient/client management + 2 ethics/jurisprudence + 4 life support. 1 CCU = at least 50 minutes of classroom or hands-on instruction. Biennium Jan 1 of an odd year to Dec 31 of the next even year; licenses expire Dec 31 of even years. Only active licensees; exemptions possible under HRS §461J-10.14.
The Board states that physical therapist assistants are currently not subject to continuing competence requirements. Licenses renew by December 31 of even-numbered years.
